title: Transition Formula Characterizes a Step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input of length $n$. For configurations $c,d$ on input $x$, suppose each has all work-tape head positions within distance $s$ of the origin and has blank contents outside that window. The transition CNF evaluated on the pair of their encoded bit assignments is true exactly when the core and output summary of the one-step successor of $c$ equal those of $d$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
Both configurations' work-tape head positions have absolute value at most $s$
